selection_reasoning: I selected 'find polished_diorite' as the single atomic task. This is a straightforward observation/navigation task where the player must locate a polished diorite block in the environment. It is easily verifiable (the player needs to look at or be near the block), requires no deep Minecraft domain knowledge beyond recognizing the block's appearance, and can be set up in a scene with clear visual landmarks. As a single task, no multi-hop dependency is needed, but the task itself can be made interesting by placing the polished diorite in a location that requires some exploration.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the freestanding polished diorite pillar at spawn-relative (5, 1, 2) and face toward it, demonstrating they have located and observed the polished diorite. Target is the center of the 2-block tall pillar placed by /setblock ~5 ~0 ~2 and /setblock ~5 ~1 ~2. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable exploration range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the block rather than facing away. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because find tasks require the player to visually observe the target, not just stand near it.

scene_description: A grassy clearing with three structures: a stone brick building (far right), an oak plank hut (back left), and a freestanding polished diorite pillar (center-right, 5 blocks from spawn). A second polished diorite column is inside the stone brick building. A cow and villager add life to the scene.
task_text: Find polished diorite in the area. Explore the nearby structures and locate the polished diorite block.
design_notes: The polished diorite pillar at ~5,0-1,2 is the primary target — a freestanding 2-block tall column about 5 blocks from spawn that visually stands out against the grass and stone brick backdrop. A secondary 3-block pillar inside the stone brick building provides additional discovery opportunity.
